flags.description: Through the 1990s, Nike's contract factories in Indonesia and Vietnam were documented (starting with a 1991 report by Jeff Ballinger) subjecting workers to poverty wages, excessive overtime, and unsafe conditions; CEO Phil Knight publicly acknowledged unfair labor practices in a May 1998 speech and committed to reforms, leading to the 1999 founding of the Fair Labor Association.

Nike's Move to Zero initiative targets zero carbon and zero waste; by fiscal year 2023 Nike sourced 96% renewable electricity across owned-and-operated facilities and launched Nike Refurbished to resell and divert lightly worn shoes from landfill.
